ITEM 1 | Bright red, juicy watermelon-like chunks with pale green-white rind edges visible on some pieces; cut into irregular cubes/wedges about 2-3 cm across, moist surface with slight sheen, holding shape, spread across the lower-left part of the plate covering roughly 30% of the plate area, about 2-3 cm tall | 150
ITEM 2 | Orange-yellow cubes with browned, caramelized edges and darker charred spots, soft-looking but holding shape, roughly 2 cm pieces, mixed with some darker brown-purple cubes, dry-looking surface with slight glaze, clustered on the right side of the plate covering roughly 25% of the plate area, about 2 cm tall | 120
ITEM 3 | Dark reddish-brown cubes with browned, slightly glossy caramelized surface, about 1.5-2 cm pieces, interspersed among the orange cubes and watermelon on the right-center of the plate, roughly 8% of plate area, about 1.5 cm tall | 45
